Game Overview

Friends Battle Knock Down puts players into a two-player experience centered on face off in a thrilling duel with your friend in Friends Battle Knock Down. Outmaneuver and push each other while dodging chaotic falling TNT. With simple controls and a 120-second clock ticking, this fast-paced, strategic showdown promises to keep you both on your toes.
